lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar majan har sare sabh kilabikh naas manaa ||
lines.translation: Take your cleansing bath in the Ambrosial Pool of the Lord, and all of your sins shall be wiped away, O my soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਜਨੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਜਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਨਾਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar sadaa majan gobi(n)d sajan dukh a(n)dheraa naase ||
lines.translation: Take your cleansing ever in the Lord God, O friends, and the pain of darkness shall be dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਟੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran na hoi tis kau katai jam ke phaase ||
lines.translation: Birth and death shall not touch you, and the noose of Death shall be cut away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਤਹਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)ge naam ra(n)ge tahaa pooran aaso ||
lines.translation: So join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and be imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; there, your hopes shall be fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa har charan kamal nivaaso ||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, shower Your Mercy upon me, O Lord, that I might dwell at Your Lotus Feet. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: tah anad binod sadaa anahad jhunakaaro raam ||
lines.translation: There is bliss and ecstasy there always, and the unstruck celestial melody resounds there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil gaavahi sa(n)t janaa prabh kaa jaikaaro raam ||
lines.translation: Meeting together, the Saints sing God's Praises, and celebrate His Victory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖਸਮ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰੰਗਿ ਭਿੰਨੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil sa(n)t gaavahi khasam bhaavahi har prem ras ra(n)g bhi(n)neeaa ||
lines.translation: Meeting together, the Saints sing the Praises of the Lord Master; they are pleasing to the Lord, and saturated with the sublime essence of His love and affection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har laabh paaiaa aap mitaaiaa mile chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||
lines.translation: They obtain the profit of the Lord, eliminate their self-conceit, and meet Him, from whom they were separated for so long.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਦਇਆ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: gahi bhujaa leene daiaa keenhe prabh ek agam apaaro ||
lines.translation: Taking them by the arm, He makes them His own; God, the One, inaccessible and infinite, bestows His kindness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sadaa niramal sach sabad run jhunakaaro ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, forever immaculate are those who sing the Praises of the True Word of the Shabad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun vadabhaageeaa har a(n)mrit baanee raam ||
lines.translation: Listen, O most fortunate ones, to the Ambrosial Bani of the Word of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau karam likhee tis ridai samaanee raam ||
lines.translation: He alone, whose karma is so pre-ordained, has it enter into his heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਾਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: akath kahaanee tinee jaanee jis aap prabh kirapaa kare ||
lines.translation: He alone knows the Unspoken Speech, unto whom God has shown His Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸਾ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: amar theeaa phir na mooaa kal kalesaa dukh hare ||
lines.translation: He becomes immortal, and shall not die again; his troubles, disputes and pains are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਾਈ ਤਜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har saran paaee taj na jaaee prabh preet man tan bhaanee ||
lines.translation: He finds the Sanctuary of the Lord; he does not forsake the Lord, and does not leave. God's Love is pleasing to his mind and body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਈਐ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sadaa gaaeeai pavitr a(n)mrit baanee ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, sing forever the Sacred Ambrosial Bani of His Word. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਗਲਤੁ ਭਏ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan galat bhae kichh kahan na jaaee raam ||
lines.translation: My mind and body are intoxicated - this state cannot be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਅੜਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੀਆ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis te upajiaRaa tin leeaa samaaee raam ||
lines.translation: We originated from Him, and into Him we shall merge once again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤੀ ਉਦਕੁ ਉਦਕਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil braham jotee ot potee udak udak samaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I merge into God's Light, through and through, like water merging into water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਨਹ ਦੂਜਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal ek raviaa nah doojaa drisataaiaa ||
lines.translation: The One Lord permeates the water, the land and the sky - I do not see any other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ban trin tribhavan poor pooran keemat kahan na jaaee ||
lines.translation: He is totally permeating the woods, meadows and the three worlds. I cannot express His worth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak aap jaanai jin eh banat banaaee ||4||2||5||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, He alone knows - He who created this creation. ||4||2||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bihaagaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bihaagraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਸੰਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojat sa(n)t phirahi prabh praan adhaare raam ||
lines.translation: The Saints go around, searching for God, the support of their breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਣੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨ ਭਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: taan tan kheen bhaiaa bin milat piaare raam ||
lines.translation: They lose the strength of their bodies, if they do not merge with their Beloved Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲੀਜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh milahu piaare maiaa dhaare kar daiaa laR laai leejeeai ||
lines.translation: O God, my Beloved, please, bestow Your kindness upon me, that I may merge with You; by Your Mercy, attach me to the hem of Your robe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਜਪਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਪੇਖੇ ਜੀਜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: dehi naam apanaa japau suaamee har daras pekhe jeejeeai ||
lines.translation: Bless me with Your Name, that I may chant it, O Lord and Master; beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: samarath pooran sadaa nihachal ooch agam apaare ||
lines.translation: He is all-powerful, perfect, eternal and unchanging, exalted, unapproachable and infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa milahu praan piaare ||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, bestow Your Mercy upon me, O Beloved of my soul, that I may merge with You. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਬਰਤ ਕੀਨੇ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਚਰਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap barat keene pekhan kau charanaa raam ||
lines.translation: I have practiced chanting, intensive meditation and fasting, to see Your Feet, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਪਤਿ ਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: tapat na katahi bujhai bin suaamee saranaa raam ||
lines.translation: But still, my burning is not quenched, without the Sanctuary of the Lord Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਾਟਿ ਬੇਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh saran teree kaat beree sa(n)saar saagar taareeai ||
lines.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary, God - please, cut away my bonds and carry me across the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਉਗਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: anaath niragun kachh na jaanaa meraa gun augan na beechaareeai ||
lines.translation: I am masterless, worthless, and I know nothing; please do not count up my merits and demerits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal gopaal preetam samarath kaaran karanaa ||
lines.translation: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, Sustainer of the world, O Beloved, Almighty Cause of causes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਮਾਗੈ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak chaatrik har boo(n)d maagai jap jeevaa har har charanaa ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak, the song-bird, begs for the rain-drop of the Lord's Name; meditating on the Feet of the Lord, Har, Har, he lives. ||2||
